To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the affinities of eight BH3 only proteins for five prosurvival BCL2 family members vary over 10 000-fold, (2) the interactions of BH3 only proteins with BCL2 family proteins are highly selective, (3) the selective engagement of specific BCL2 family prosurvival members by their cognate BH3 only protein is required for apoptosis, and (4) the selective engagement and inhibition of specific prosurvival members is a promising strategy
the binding of BH3 only proteins to prosurvival BCL 2 proteins is highly specific and that this specificity allows complementary apoptotic functions.
the binding affinities of the BH3 only ligand peptides for the Bcl 1 like proteins are highly variable and that the binding of the peptides for different prosurvival proteins is complementary.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of apoptosis by the Bcl
how apoptosis is initiated and how it is inhibited in the cell.
the mechanisms by which cells die, or fail to die, in response to a range of signals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BH3 peptides are selective for their prosurvival BCL2 family partners.
Bcl 2 family proteins are not promiscuous, that their interactions are highly selective, that the interactions vary widely in affinity, and that these interactions are critical for apoptosis.
the BH3 only proteins have different binding affinities for the prosurvival BCL 2 proteins and that this is the basis of their complementary functions in the regulation of apoptosis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Bcl 1-2 proteins are a family of proteins that can be targeted by a number of different BH3 only ligand proteins.
the BH3 only proteins are not promiscuous in that they bind differentially to the prosurvival BCl 2 family members and that these interactions are critical for apoptosis.

Bim and PUMA bind to all the prosurvivial proteins, BAD to Bcl2, Bcl-xL, and BcL-w, and Noxa only binds to MCL1 and A1, which are the only two prosurvival proteins that are upregulated during apoptosis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Bcl 1 family proteins have a range of affinity for BH3 peptides, and that this is important for their function.
the BH3 only proteins are differentially targeted by prosurvival BCL2 family proteins and this targeting can be exploited therapeutically.
there is no such thing as promiscuity in the Bcl 1 family.
